pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal dark regions exhibiting smooth pixel gradients at the edges due to image blur. Spatial area is greatest in the central flank and decreases in size toward the posterior region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of lighter pelage forming a negative-space topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform but lacks sharp definition due to noise and low resolution.
